=== clauses/set/Set2.feature [1]
setup
  CREATE (:A {property1: 23, property2: 46})
query
  MATCH (n:A)
  SET n.property1 = null
  RETURN n
expect bag
  | n                    |
  | (:A {property2: 46}) |
side-effects
  | -properties | 1 |
=== clauses/set/Set2.feature [2]
setup
  CREATE (:A {name: 'Michael', age: 35})
query
  MATCH (n)
  WHERE n.name = 'Michael'
  SET n.name = null
  RETURN n
expect bag
  | n              |
  | (:A {age: 35}) |
side-effects
  | -properties | 1 |
=== clauses/set/Set2.feature [3]
setup
  CREATE ()-[:REL {property1: 12, property2: 24}]->()
query
  MATCH ()-[r]->()
  SET r.property1 = null
  RETURN r
expect bag
  | r                      |
  | [:REL {property2: 24}] |
side-effects
  | -properties | 1 |

=== clauses/set/Set6.feature [5]
setup
  CREATE (:N {num: 1})
  CREATE (:N {num: 2})
  CREATE (:N {num: 3})
  CREATE (:N {num: 4})
  CREATE (:N {num: 5})
query
  MATCH (n:N)
  SET n.num = n.num + 1
  WITH n
  WHERE n.num % 2 = 0
  RETURN n.num AS num
expect bag
  | num |
  | 2   |
  | 4   |
  | 6   |
side-effects
  | +properties | 5 |
  | -properties | 5 |

=== clauses/remove/Remove1.feature [1]
setup
  CREATE (:L {num: 42})
query
  MATCH (n)
  REMOVE n.num
  RETURN n.num IS NOT NULL AS still_there
expect bag
  | still_there |
  | false       |
side-effects
  | -properties | 1 |
=== clauses/remove/Remove1.feature [3]
setup
  CREATE (a), (b), (a)-[:X {num: 42}]->(b)
query
  MATCH ()-[r]->()
  REMOVE r.num
  RETURN r.num IS NOT NULL AS still_there
expect bag
  | still_there |
  | false       |
side-effects
  | -properties | 1 |
=== clauses/remove/Remove1.feature [5]

  REMOVE a.num
  RETURN a
expect bag
  | a    |
  | null |
side-effects none
=== clauses/remove/Remove1.feature [6]

  RETURN n
expect bag

  | ({num: 42}) |
side-effects none

=== clauses/remove/Remove1.feature [2]
query
  MATCH (n)
  REMOVE n.num, n.name
  RETURN size(keys(n)) AS props
expect reject-profile
side-effects none

=== clauses/remove/Remove1.feature [4]
query

  REMOVE r.num, r.a
  RETURN size(keys(r)) AS props
expect reject-profile
side-effects none
